connector.name: OpenRouter by tsilva
connector.registryDescription: MCP server providing access to 300+ AI models via OpenRouter
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-openrouter. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tsilva account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
